source.title: How I Made Gemma 4 10x Faster on Jetson Orin Nano
source.author: Unknown

athena.directive: Leverage breakthroughs in edge-optimized Large Language Models to establish the Creative Liberation Engine as the sovereign leader in distributed, real-time AI, prioritizing on-device intelligence and minimizing external dependencies.
athena.rationale: The demonstrated 10x speedup of Gemma 4 on a Jetson Orin Nano signifies a critical inflection point for edge AI. Such performance unlocks unprecedented capabilities for autonomous systems, aligning perfectly with the Creative Liberation Engine's constitutional mandate for sovereignty (Article I) and complete, high-quality implementations (Article IV, Article IX). This strategic direction ensures the Creative Liberation Engine remains at the forefront of AI innovation by embracing efficient, localized processing.

options.title: Edge AI Dominance with Hyper-Optimized LLMs
options.description: Focus on integrating and deploying highly optimized Large Language Models, such as the demonstrated Gemma 4 equivalent, directly onto Creative Liberation Engine's edge hardware. This strategy aims to enable real-time, low-latency AI applications without cloud dependency, reinforcing Article I: Sovereignty by minimizing reliance on external infrastructure.
options.tradeoffs: Requires significant investment in researching and adapting existing Creative Liberation Engine architectures for edge hardware compatibility. The development of robust, self-hosted optimization pipelines will be complex and resource-intensive, potentially extending initial deployment timelines.

options.title: Creative Liberation Engine Internal LLM Optimization Research
options.description: Initiate a dedicated internal research and development track to reverse-engineer and replicate the optimization techniques that achieved the 10x speedup for Gemma 4. Apply these learnings to Creative Liberation Engine's proprietary models or core components to achieve similar performance gains across various target hardware, including existing and future edge devices.
options.tradeoffs: Requires substantial allocation of R&D resources and specialized talent. The specific optimization techniques might not be publicly disclosed or directly transferable, leading to a potentially lengthy and uncertain development cycle. Success is not guaranteed.

options.title: Strategic Partnership for Edge-Optimized LLMs
options.description: Explore and establish strategic partnerships with external entities or research groups that have demonstrated expertise in optimizing LLMs for edge devices. This could involve licensing proprietary technologies, collaborative development, or acquiring specialized talent to rapidly integrate edge-optimized LLMs into the Creative Liberation Engine.
options.tradeoffs: Potential compromise of Article I: Sovereignty due to reliance on external intellectual property or services. Dependency on third-party roadmaps and potential alignment challenges could introduce external points of failure or delays. Financial costs associated with partnerships may be substantial.
